Metadata.title: Project Angel Food | Cooking and Delivering Healthy Meals
Metadata.description: Project Angel Food cooks and delivers healthy meals to feed people impacted by serious illness, bringing comfort and hope every day.

HomePage.heroTitle: Cooking and Delivering Healthy Meals to People Impacted by Serious Illness
HomePage.heroSubtitle: Project Angel Food cooks and delivers over 2,500 nutritious meals daily to our most vulnerable neighbors across Los Angeles.
HomePage.missionText: Project Angel Food prepares and delivers healthy meals to feed people impacted by serious illness, nourishing their bodies, uplifting their spirits, and bringing comfort when it's needed most.
HomePage.medicallyTailoredDesc: Our meals are designed by registered dietitians and prepared by professional chefs to meet the specific nutritional needs of each client.
HomePage.homeDeliveryDesc: Meals are delivered directly to our clients' homes by our dedicated volunteers, ensuring no one goes without nourishment.
HomePage.nutritionServicesDesc: Our team of registered dietitians provides individualized nutrition counseling and education to every client.
HomePage.ctaText: Your support helps us cook and deliver life-sustaining meals to our most vulnerable neighbors. Every donation makes a difference.

AboutPage.title: About Project Angel Food
AboutPage.intro: Since 1989, Project Angel Food has been cooking and delivering nutritious meals to men, women, and children affected by life-threatening illnesses.
AboutPage.historyText: Founded in 1989 in response to the AIDS crisis, Project Angel Food began as a small group of volunteers cooking meals in a church kitchen. Today, we are one of the largest meal delivery programs in the country, serving over 2,500 meals every day.
AboutPage.compassionDesc: We treat every client with dignity, respect, and kindness.
AboutPage.excellenceDesc: We are committed to the highest standards of nutrition and service.
AboutPage.communityDesc: We believe in the power of people coming together to help those in need.
AboutPage.inclusionDesc: We serve all people regardless of background, identity, or circumstance.
AboutPage.teamText: Our dedicated leadership team guides our mission to serve those in need across Los Angeles County.

ProgramsPage.title: Our Programs
ProgramsPage.subtitle: Comprehensive nutrition support for people living with serious illness
ProgramsPage.mtmDesc: Our signature program delivers meals specifically designed to address the dietary needs and restrictions of each client's medical diagnosis. Every recipe is developed by registered dietitians and prepared by professional chefs.
ProgramsPage.deliveryDesc: Our volunteer-powered delivery program brings meals directly to clients' homes throughout Los Angeles County. We deliver to over 2,500 clients daily, ensuring that no one goes hungry.
ProgramsPage.nutritionDesc: Our registered dietitians work one-on-one with clients to provide personalized nutrition counseling and education, empowering them to make healthy choices.
ProgramsPage.groceryDesc: In addition to prepared meals, we provide bags of fresh groceries to supplement clients' nutritional needs and support their overall wellbeing.
ProgramsPage.eligibilityText: We serve men, women, and children living with critical illnesses including HIV/AIDS, cancer, kidney failure, diabetes, congestive heart failure, and other life-threatening diseases.
ProgramsPage.applyText: To apply for services, please contact us by phone or complete our online referral form. A member of our team will guide you through the process.

DonatePage.title: Support Our Mission
DonatePage.subtitle: Your generous donation helps us cook and deliver life-sustaining meals to people battling serious illness.
DonatePage.feedOne: Feeds one client for a week
DonatePage.feedTwo: Feeds two clients for a week
DonatePage.feedMonth: Feeds one client for a month
DonatePage.feedYear: Provides meals for a client for 3 months
DonatePage.taxDeductible: Your donation is tax-deductible. Project Angel Food is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.
DonatePage.plannedGivingDesc: Include Project Angel Food in your estate planning to create a lasting legacy of compassion.
DonatePage.corporatePartnersDesc: Partner with us to make a meaningful impact in your community while aligning your brand with a worthy cause.
DonatePage.inKindDesc: Donate food, supplies, or services to directly support our meal preparation and delivery operations.
